title: Accounting standards, disclosure and comparability
review_type: Author financial, mathematical, source, instructional and prompt-solution review; coordinator acceptance pending

scope.teach_back: Answered prompt with criteria, equation and evidence/version check
scope.artifacts: Full static manuscript; exact synthetic JSON cases; standard-library benchmark; preserved strict-JSON output; README; independent focused checker; nine scoped primary-source proposals

financial_review: Report identity, legal and group perimeter, calendar, units/currency, framework, standard/adoption version, original/revised comparative and source locator precede ratios or adjustments.

Recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure are distinguished with original examples. An analytical common-basis bridge is separated from a permitted accounting-policy election and from causal/economic comparability.

instruction_review: Every computational exercise has its method introduced in sections3–6 or cited prerequisites; all eight prompts have complete determinate answers or explicit evaluation criteria.
Three original cases have separate entity/timing/unit conventions; the no-tax limitation is confined to the first two cases, while segment tax13 is supplied expense without cash assumptions.
Policy permissions, actual useful-life evidence, materiality, practicability and segment reportability are not asserted by the numerical program. Unknown segment CFO is null rather than zero.

Historical and revised disclosures are preserved separately to distinguish ex-post corrected analysis from information available at a decision date. Real-world intent or audit assurance is not inferred.

source_review.actually_inspected: Actual IFRS IAS8/IAS2/IFRS8/IFRS18 About/history bodies; AASB108 2023–2026 operative metadata and scoped paragraphs; AASB8 2021–2026 metadata and segments/measurement/reconciliation/comparatives paragraphs; actual FASB2015-11 and2023-07 PDF front matter, summary and relevant amendments; SEC manual6310.1–.3 and neighboring6320.1–.2.
source_review.dated_framework_limits: IFRS18 mandatory2027 and earlier-application permission are not conflated with an issuer adoption date. Renamed IAS8 public page is identified. AASB local/Tier2 clauses are not generalized. FASB ASUs are amendment communications rather than standalone authoritative Codification.
source_review.access_limit: Full gated IFRS normative texts and complete current FASB Codification were not inspected. Source proposals give the exact body/paragraph scope; no source problems or illustrations reproduced.

checks: Quiet strict-JSON benchmark API and preserved output agree; independent expanded-unit cost and external-cash/net-asset oracle
Four inventory probes: full liquidation, identical costs, falling costs and zero sales
Independent cumulative-depreciation oracle, opening-comparative correction split and four remaining-life/residual probes
Segment revenue/expense/profit/assets reconciliation and matched internal transfer invariance; missing CFO stays null
All determinate exercise and retention results independently recomputed; open source/evidence answers read against criteria
Four consequential wrong-report mutations detected: closing-reserve income, invented cash, incorrect reserve bridge and prior error in current profit
Fourteen financially consequential invalid funding, quantity, timing, precision, asset-life and segment contracts rejected
Normal and optimized benchmark CLI run from /tmp matches API; three worked examples/eight matching solutions/four downloads/answered retrieval/nine used source routes

findings.finding: Absolute retained-earnings answers required an initial balance not explicitly supplied.
findings.resolution: Added the explicit assumption that opening-X1 retained earnings are zero; final prompt re-read against the solution and hashed after correction.

limitations: Author review and executable checks are not independent human academic/accounting certification or a filing opinion.
No full current framework equivalence, tax/election result, actual source evidence about an issuer, legal jurisdiction conclusion, fraud identification or audit assurance is established.

The lab implements stated no-tax simple unit FIFO/LIFO and straight-line cases plus a partial segment disclosure packet; dollar-value LIFO, taxes, impairment, complex transitions and comprehensive segment reportability are outside scope.

The independent unit-expansion inventory oracle covers integer quantities in original/probe cases. The benchmark supports rational quantities, but no exhaustive generic-software verification is claimed.
No browser/mobile/print/visual QA performed; coordinator owns shared structure, canonical source registration, dependency acceptance and publication.
